page_title: LYO 3-2 MON | Lyon v Monaco 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Monaco will take a free kick from near the half-way line.
90+3' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Mama Balde (Lyon) is on for Alexandre Lacazette.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
89' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
89' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
88' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
88' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) gets his head on the corner, but he sees his header blocked. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
87' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

87' A wonderful opportunity! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the top left corner. However, Radoslaw Majecki makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the post. Now Lyon have a corner.
87' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.
86' It looks like Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) saw red with that tackle. Bastien Dechepy won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
84' 3 - 2 Malick Fofana (Lyon) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Alexandre Lacazette. He takes the shot early and scores!
83' Malick Fofana (Lyon) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
82' Breel Embolo (Monaco) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
81' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:3.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Orel Mangala (Lyon) comes onto the pitch so that Corentin Tolisso can be given a rest.
79' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Monaco players look gutted.
79' Attention! Referee Bastien Dechepy straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
78' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) has a goal ruled out for offside!
77' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Monaco.
76' Anthony Lopes makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Breel Embolo (Monaco) after a cross from the side.
76' Monaco are seeing far more of the ball now.
74' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) commits a foul after dangerous play.
72' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post.
71' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) picks out Rayan Cherki with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lyon.
70' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
70' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
69' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
69' A pass by Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
67' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
67' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Alexandre Lacazette.
66' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is lurking on the edge of the box and receives a pass from Kassoum Ouattara. He shows nice control before hitting a soft shot just wide of the left post.
66' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Ernest Nuamah and he is replaced by Malick Fofana (Lyon).
65' We are about to witness a subsitution. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) for Said Benrahma.
64' Breel Embolo (Monaco) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
63' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
62' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
60' 2 - 2 Goal! Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) makes the score 2:2 after burying a close-range header in the bottom right corner after a good run and cross by Youssouf Fofana.
59' Said Benrahma (Lyon) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
58' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Breel Embolo (Monaco) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.

57' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Monaco will take a corner.
56' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.
55' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) meets a cross from Clinton Mata, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the right post.
54' Said Benrahma (Lyon) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
53' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) but poses no threat.
52' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) picks up a long through ball, but Radoslaw Majecki deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
50' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
48' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) commits a foul and Bastien Dechepy immediately signals a free kick.
47' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Folarin Balogun is replaced by Breel Embolo (Monaco).
46' Adi Hutter has made a change at the break. Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) has come on in place of Guillermo Maripan.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Vanderson comes off for Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Vanderson (Monaco) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
45+3' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) probably handled the ball.
45+3' Said Benrahma (Lyon) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
45+2' Said Benrahma (Lyon) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
45+1' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
42' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
40' Neat link-up play between Said Benrahma (Lyon) and Alexandre Lacazette, but Radoslaw Majecki reads the game well and the move breaks down.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Said Benrahma (Lyon) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' 52:48 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
36' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
34' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) sprays a pass out to Corentin Tolisso, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
32' Said Benrahma (Lyon) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
32' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
31' The ball is out of play and Lyon manage to earn a corner.

30' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Lyon force a corner. They send men into the box.
29' Said Benrahma (Lyon) swings it in and Alexandre Lacazette gets on the end of it, but Radoslaw Majecki shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
28' Said Benrahma (Lyon) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
26' 2 - 1 Goal! Said Benrahma (Lyon) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:1.
25' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Takumi Minamino (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
22' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Said Benrahma sprays a pass out to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
21' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
19' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Anthony Lopes was alert and made a comfortable save.
17' Lyon couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
15' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
14' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
12' Referee Bastien Dechepy sees the trip by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
11' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
10' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Monaco.
9' The linesman raises his flag. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is adjudged offside.
7' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
5' Vanderson (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
2' Referee Bastien Dechepy points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) goes wild in celebration.
2' The Monaco players joy may have been justified, because referee Bastien Dechepy is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
1' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
1' 0 - 1 Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom right corner, leaving the keeper helpless.
1' The match has just started.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Bastien Dechepy.
